pins.definition: Moving or able to move at high speed.

situation: A teenager is sprinting down a sidewalk, blurring past a parked bicycle, in order to catch the closing doors of a city bus.
subject: the rapid motion
brief: A teenager in a hoodie is caught in mid-stride, body leaning sharply forward into the sprint. Behind him, the parked bicycle and the street lamps are rendered with long, horizontal motion-blur streaks, emphasizing his high speed as he closes the distance to the bus doors ahead.
